channel.title: Small Town Woman - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Small Town Woman (smalltownwoman.com)

item.title: Ramen Stir Fry
item.description: This Ramen Stir Fry is a quick and easy flavor packed main meal made with everyday ramen noodles, crisp stir fried vegetables and a six ingredient sauce that will leave you licking your plate.

item.title: Buffalo Chicken Mac and Cheese
item.description: Delicious homemade Buffalo chicken mac and cheese combines rotisserie chicken, sweet onions, garlic, and elbow macaroni in a rich, creamy cheese sauce, topped with crispy, toasted panko breadcrumbs.

item.title: Johnny Marzetti
item.description: Johnny Marzetti Casserole features ground beef, sausage, mushrooms, onions, and bell peppers, in tomato sauce, all smothered with cheddar and mozzarella.

item.title: Dumpling Soup
item.description: This delicious dumpling soup combines carrots, spinach, and potstickers in a vegetable broth with hints of garlic and ginger. It is one of our favorite soups and is so easy to make.

item.title: Scalloped Corn
item.description: This quick and easy scalloped corn is comfort food at its best, with a creamy base seasoned with paprika and a pinch of nutmeg, and a savory, buttery cracker-crumb topping.

item.title: Classic Beef Chili Recipe
item.description: This beef chili combines ground beef, onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, pinto and kidney beans in a perfectly seasoned broth with a little kick from chipotle peppers and adobo sauce.

item.title: Sauteed Carrots
item.description: These easy sauteed carrots are cooked in butter and seasoned with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and fresh herbs.

item.title: Taco Pasta Salad
item.description: Easy Taco Pasta Salad brings taco seasoned ground beef, pasta, tomatoes, black beans, cheddar and scallions together into a creamy slightly spicy easy to pull together ranch dressing.

item.title: Ham and Lentil Soup
item.description: This Ham and Lentil Soup features onions, celery, carrots, tomatoes, dried lentils, and smoked ham in a savory and smoky broth.

item.title: Dutch Baby Pancakes
item.description: The Dutch Baby Pancake is a puffy, oversized pancake similar to Yorkshire pudding. This quick-to-prepare pancake is ready for the pan in about 5 minutes.
